The season began on 30 January 2016. [[UMS de Loum]] dominated the league, winning their first title by a 10-point margin over runner-up [[Coton Sport FC de Garoua|Cotonsport]]. It was a significant turnaround for UMS de Loum, who finished tied for 11th in 2015, just four points away from relegation. ==Teams locations== {{Location map+ |Cameroon |width=525 |float=center |caption=Locations of the 2016 Elite One teams |places= {{Location map~ |Cameroon |lat=5.453583 |long=10.065036 |label=[[Aigle Royal Menoua|Aigle Royal]] |position=left}} {{Location map~ |Cameroon |lat=3.885481 |long=11.540607 |label=[[APEJES Academy|APEJES]]
